Gulf Drug LLC
is a B2B healthcare solutions provider and distributor, but
it does not specifically focus on or market consumer/wearable medical devices
. Its core portfolio centers on large-scale medical equipment, clinical instruments, pharmaceuticals, laboratory consumables, and turnkey hospital projects.

Gulf Drug LLC
is
a major regional healthcare supply and medical equipment distributor in the UAE
, but it does not primarily manufacture or act as a specialized direct consumer vendor for standalone retail smartwatches, wearable ECGs, sleep trackers, or direct-to-consumer continuous glucose monitors.
Wearable & Remote Monitoring Overview
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Systems like the FreeStyle Libre or Dexcom track interstitial glucose levels in real time.

Smartwatches & Wearable ECG:
Consumer devices (such as the Apple Watch or specialized health watches) offer spot-check ECGs, pulse oximetry, and heart-rate variability tracking.
Sleep Trackers & Rings:
Dedicated form factors like smart rings focus on recovery metrics, skin temperature, and sleep stages.

Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM):
Clinical setups use connected hubs and cellular gateways to relay multi-parameter vital signs back to hospital systems.
